text: Detector.idt now implements the canonical minimum-duration sliding-window procedure. Before qualification, a failing window advances exactly one oldest sample and is reconsidered; after qualification, the fixation expands maximally and its first violating sample becomes the next candidate. Blink, Lost, and OffScreen terminate support. The threshold is per-axis Extent, while emitted dispersion is explicitly BoundingBoxDiagonal. Candidate storage is a persistent two-stack queue whose stack aggregates maintain x/y extrema in O(1) amortized enqueue/dequeue; summaries traverse support once only at emission. The final sample receives one mean observed interval of half-open tail support, preserving existing event interval semantics.
